themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad spectrum of AI tools designed to assist in various research activities, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI models and tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles on AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, such as research papers, meeting transcripts, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Discusses how AI is being applied to enhance product management workflows, from ideation to market analysis.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Covers AI applications in creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys to gather user feedback and insights.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Focuses on articles directly comparing the performance, features, or effectiveness of different AI research tools.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the research, development, and user interaction with AI-powered chatbots for various applications.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates the effects of AI on jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including recruitment and job creation/displacement.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
